how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-northshire-valley-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:783:details:0: I hope you strapped your belt on tight, young ⟦1⟧, because there is work to do here in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:783:details:2: The ⟦E3⟧ guards are hard pressed to keep the peace here, with so many of us in distant lands and so many threats pressing close. And so we're enlisting the aid of anyone willing to defend their home. And their alliance.
rows.quest:783:details:3: If you're here to answer the call, then speak with my superior, ⟦E1⟧. He's inside the abbey behind me.
rows.quest:783:completion:0: Ah, good. Another volunteer. We're getting a lot of you these days.
rows.quest:783:completion:2: The human lands are threatened from without, and so many of our forces have been marshaled abroad. This, in turn, leaves room for corrupt and lawless groups to thrive within our borders.
rows.quest:783:completion:3: It is a many-fronted battle we wage, ⟦2⟧. Gird yourself for a long campaign.
rows.quest:7:details:0: Your first task is one of cleansing, ⟦3⟧. A clan of kobolds have infested the woods to the north. Go there and fight the kobold vermin you find. Reduce their numbers so that we may one day drive them from ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:7:progress:0: How goes the hunting, ⟦4⟧? Have you found and defeated those vermin?
rows.quest:7:completion:0: Well done, citizen. Those kobolds are thieves and cowards, but in large numbers they pose a threat to us. And the humans of ⟦E3⟧ do not need another threat.
rows.quest:7:completion:1: For defeating them, you have my gratitude.
rows.quest:33:details:0: I hate those nasty timber wolves! But I sure like eating wolf steaks... Bring me tough wolf meat and I will exchange it for something you'll find useful.
rows.quest:33:details:1: Tough wolf meat is gathered from hunting the timber wolves and young wolves wandering the ⟦E2⟧ countryside.
rows.quest:33:progress:0: Hey ⟦5⟧. I'm getting hungry...did you get that tough wolf meat?
rows.quest:33:completion:0: You've been busy! I can't wait to cook up that wolf meat...
rows.quest:33:completion:1: I have some things here you want - take your pick!
rows.quest:5261:details:0: ⟦E8⟧ is looking for someone to hunt wolves for him. That's good news, because we're seeing a lot more wolves in ⟦E10⟧ lately.
rows.quest:5261:details:1: If you're interested then speak with Eagan. He's around the side of the abbey, to the left.
rows.quest:5261:completion:0: That's true. I'm looking for someone to hunt me some wolves! Are you that person?
rows.quest:15:obj:0: Kill 10 Kobold Workers, then report back to ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:15:details:0: ⟦6⟧, my scouts tell me that the kobold infestation is larger than we had thought. A group of kobold workers has camped near the Echo Ridge Mine to the north.
rows.quest:15:details:1: Go to the mine and remove them. We know there are at least 10. Kill them, see if there are more, then report back to me.
rows.quest:15:progress:0: Have you been to the mines? Are you ready to report?
rows.quest:15:completion:0: I don't like hearing of all these kobolds in our mine. No good can come of this. Here, take this as payment, and when you're ready, speak to me again. I would like you to go back to the mines one more time...
rows.quest:18:obj:0: Bring 12 Red Burlap Bandanas to ⟦E11⟧ outside the ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:18:details:0: Recently, a new group of thieves has been hanging around ⟦E2⟧. They call themselves the Defias Brotherhood, and have been seen across the river to the east.
rows.quest:18:details:1: I don't know what they're up to, but I'm sure it's not good! Bring me the bandanas they wear, and I'll reward you with a weapon.
rows.quest:18:progress:0: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
rows.quest:18:completion:0: Back with some bandanas, I see. The ⟦E3⟧ Army appreciates your help.
rows.quest:3903:details:0: You've shown yourself a dependable ⟦7⟧, ⟦8⟧. Dependable, and not afraid to get your hands dirty, eh?
rows.quest:3903:details:1: I have a friend, ⟦E13⟧, who's in some trouble. She's over with her wagon on the other side of the abbey, near the stable. I'm sure she could use a pair of hands like yours.
rows.quest:3903:completion:0: Oh, ⟦E11⟧ told you to speak with me? He's a brave man and always willing to help, but his duties keep him stuck at ⟦E9⟧ and I'm afraid the problem I have today is beyond him.
rows.quest:3904:details:0: A gang of brigands, the Defias, moved into the ⟦E2⟧ Vineyards while I was harvesting! I reported it to the ⟦E2⟧ guards and they assured me they'd take care of things, but... I'm afraid for my crop of grapes! If the Defias don't steal them then I fear our guards will trample them when they chase away the thugs.
rows.quest:3904:details:1: Please, you must help me! I gathered most of my grapes into buckets, but I left them in the vineyards to the southeast.
rows.quest:3904:details:2: Bring me those buckets! Save my harvest!
rows.quest:3904:completion:0: Oh thank you, ⟦10⟧! You saved my harvest! And I hope you showed a few of those Defias that they can't cause trouble around here.
rows.quest:3904:completion:1: We might be short on guards these days, but we're lucky to have heroes like you to protect us!
rows.quest:3905:details:0: Now that my crop is saved, take this ⟦E16⟧ to ⟦E17⟧. He manages the store of food and drink in ⟦E2⟧, and I'm sure he'll be delighted to hear that he has fresh grapes.
rows.quest:3905:details:1: You'll find ⟦E17⟧ in the abbey, in the bell tower... where he likes to taste his wine.
rows.quest:3905:progress:0: You look to be in fine spirits! Come! Have a seat, and have a drink!
rows.quest:3905:completion:1: Oh my! Milly's grapes have been saved! When she told me that brigands overran her vineyards I nearly despaired, but my faith in the Light did not waver!
rows.quest:3905:completion:2: And through your bravery, we now have grapes for more wine! May the Light bless you, ⟦11⟧, and keep you safe!
rows.quest:6:obj:0: Kill ⟦E18⟧ and bring his head to ⟦E11⟧ at ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:6:details:0: ⟦E18⟧ - a cutthroat who's plagued our farmers and merchants for weeks - was seen at a shack near the vineyards, which lies east of the Abbey and across the bridge. Bring me the villain's head, and earn his bounty!
rows.quest:6:details:1: But be wary, ⟦12⟧. Garrick has gathered a gang of thugs around him. He will not be an easy man to reach.
rows.quest:6:progress:0: Did you find Garrick's shack? Are we finally free of that villain?
rows.quest:6:completion:0: Hah - you caught him! You've done Elwynn a great service, and earned a nice bounty!
rows.quest:21:obj:0: Kill 12 Kobold Laborers, then return to ⟦E1⟧ at ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:21:details:0: Your previous investigations are proof that the Echo Ridge Mine needs purging. Return to the mine and help clear it of kobolds.
rows.quest:21:details:1: Waste no time, ⟦13⟧. The longer the kobolds are left unmolested in the mine, the deeper a foothold they gain in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:21:progress:0: I know it's bloody work, ⟦14⟧, but it's vital to the safety of ⟦E2⟧. Are you ready to report?
rows.quest:21:completion:0: Once again, you have earned my respect, and the gratitude of the ⟦E3⟧ Army. There may yet be kobolds in the mine, but I will marshal others against them. We have further tasks for you.
rows.quest:54:details:0: ⟦15⟧, you are a ⟦16⟧ with proven interest in the security of ⟦E2⟧. You are now tasked with the protection of the surrounding ⟦E21⟧.
rows.quest:54:details:1: If you accept this duty, then I have prepared papers that must be delivered to ⟦E20⟧ in Goldshire. Goldshire lies along the southern road, past the border gates.
rows.quest:54:progress:0: You have word from McBride? ⟦E2⟧ is a garden compared to ⟦E21⟧, but I wonder what ⟦E1⟧ has to report.⟦17⟧⟦18⟧Here, let me have his papers...
rows.quest:54:completion:0: Well, it says here that you've been awarded Acting Deputy Status with the ⟦E3⟧ Marshals. Congratulations.
rows.quest:54:completion:1: And good luck - keeping Elwynn safe is no picnic... what with most the army busy doing who knows what for who knows which noble!
rows.quest:54:completion:2: It's hard to keep track of politics in these dark days...
